presets.name: Sepia
presets.summary: Four warm browns behind the waves.
presets.description: The shape color follows the background automatically, picking whichever of black and white contrasts more, so changing the palette carries the whole picture.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: Four greys, no hue at all.
presets.description: Useful for a print stylesheet, a disabled state, or anywhere color would carry meaning it should not.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.description: A single background hue means every avatar shares it and only the waves changes. The most restrained this style gets.

presets.name: Muted
presets.summary: Six dusty backgrounds instead of the bright ones.
presets.description: The style ships a saturated background palette. This trades it for dusty tones, for interfaces where the avatar should be present without being the loudest thing on screen.

presets.name: Electric
presets.description: The other direction on the same lever: six colors past anything the style ships.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.description: The lightest way to make a set of avatars feel like it belongs together.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.description: The loud counterpart to Pastel Wall, strong enough that the avatar holds its own against a busy page.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient behind the waves.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. The seed still decides which of the two ends up on top.

presets.name: Stencil
presets.summary: One background for everyone, only the drawing varies.
presets.description: Every avatar gets the same near-black ground, so nothing distinguishes them but the drawing itself. That turns a set from a group of portraits into an icon sheet.

presets.name: Animated
presets.summary: Turns the style's built-in animation on.
presets.description: The animation is off by default and `animation: true` switches it on. `animationSpeed` sets the pace. The motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.summary: Scaled in, so the pattern runs past the edge.
presets.description: Uses scale rather than color. Cropping in turns the composition from a complete picture into a detail of a larger one, which reads better at small sizes.
